_doc: Category-31 (Sweeteners and Syrups) compiler config for tools/standards/compile-cat31.mjs — HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default). Numbers come ONLY from data/evidence/regulatory_limits.csv, selected per subcategory by explicit scope regex, strictest across jurisdictions, at FACE VALUE. HONEY is the load-bearing case the honey-Pb near-miss warns about: it HAS sovereign MLs (Israel Pb 100, MERCOSUR/Paraguay Cd 100 / tAs 300, Vietnam tHg 50), so every honey cell resolves to a government value — a pooled-occurrence method would have published ~14x the real ceiling, which is structurally impossible here. Sugar and syrup MLs (Israel FCS Sugar, MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011 sugars, Paraguay Decreto 1335, Vietnam QCVN 8-2, Singapore Food Regs) govern the sweeteners. Rice/grain syrup inorganic arsenic is a DISCLOSED read-across from the EU non-parboiled milled-rice iAs ML (150) because the arsenic derives from the rice, and that stricter rice value beats the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500). Molasses/rice-syrup nickel is held under a mineral-concentration screen (control). Aluminium/tin/total-chromium have no sweetener pathway (not-material); Cr-VI is the reflex-speciation control; methylmercury has no methylation pathway in a sugar matrix (not-material).

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for honey; total arsenic is governed (300 ug/kg, MERCOSUR/Paraguay). Inorganic arsenic is the toxic species and is obtained by reflex speciation when total arsenic is elevated.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for honey and no concentration pathway operates: honey is a nectar sugar with trace mineral content, not a nickel accumulator or a hydrogenated/mineral-concentrated product. Rebuttable and audited against the register each build.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for honey; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. No chromium concentration pathway operates in a nectar sugar. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any lot whose total-chromium screen exceeds the reflex trigger is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; honey is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for honey and no aluminium uptake or migration pathway operates in a nectar sugar. Rebuttable and audited each build.

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury forms by aquatic microbial methylation and bioaccumulates in fish; honey has no methylation pathway and no mercury source. Total mercury is governed (50 ug/kg, Vietnam).

iAs.rationale: Israel FCS sets an inorganic-arsenic ML for sugar (500 ug/kg); it is the sole sovereign sugar iAs value and is looser than the governed total-arsenic value (100, MERCOSUR/Paraguay). The toxic species is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic rather than by publishing the loose direct iAs number.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for refined sugar; refining removes minerals rather than concentrating them, so no nickel-concentration pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for sugar; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; refined sugar is sold in paper/plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for refined sugar and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no mercury source in a refined sugar. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

syrups-maple-agave-molasses.name: Syrups (maple, agave, molasses)
syrups-maple-agave-molasses.lineage_note: Syrups are treated as sugars: the strictest sovereign sugar/syrup ML governs (Pb/tAs 100 MERCOSUR-Paraguay 'sugars'; Cd 150 / iAs-controlled Israel 'Sugar'; tHg 50 Vietnam 'Sugar'). Two feasibility flags for staff, NOT resolved here: (1) maple syrup carries a documented lead pathway from legacy lead-soldered evaporators and tapping hardware, so the strict Pb 100 is protective and appropriate; (2) molasses concentrates minerals and lead during sugar extraction and may not meet Pb 100 without clean sourcing — a feasibility-driven transition, not a reason to loosen the government-anchored ceiling.

iAs.rationale: Israel FCS sets an inorganic-arsenic ML for sugar (500 ug/kg), the sole sovereign value and looser than the governed total arsenic (100). The toxic species is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for syrups, but molasses concentrates minerals (including nickel) during repeated sugar extraction, so a real concentration pathway exists. Held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; molasses monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for any sweetener (the only food total-Cr MLs in the register are dairy), so there is no number to publish. But the not-material 'no chromium pathway' claim is factually wrong for the molasses member of this combined maple/agave/molasses cell: molasses is a documented chromium concentrate (reported total Cr ~0.27 mg/kg, the highest-Cr sweetener, molasses >> refined white sugar), produced by the same repeated sugar-extraction mineral-concentration pathway that already holds nickel under control in this exact cell. Total chromium is therefore held under a mandatory ICP-MS screen under ALARA rather than declared not-material, with Cr-VI remaining the reflex-speciation control. Rebuttable and audited against the register each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS on each lot under ALARA; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (IC-ICP-MS) on any elevated total-Cr screen.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these syrups are sold in glass/plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for syrups and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no mercury source in a sugar syrup. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

rice-grain-syrup.name: Rice and grain syrup (brown rice syrup, glucose/malt syrup)
rice-grain-syrup.lineage_note: Rice and grain syrups are treated as sugars for Pb/Cd/tAs/tHg (strictest sovereign sugar ML). Inorganic arsenic is the load-bearing cell: brown rice syrup is a documented iAs vector (it has been used as a sweetener in infant and toddler foods), and the arsenic derives from the rice, so the cell is a disclosed read-across from the EU non-parboiled milled-rice iAs ML (150) — stricter than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500) and source-appropriate. Rice/grain syrup DESTINED FOR infant or young-child food falls under the stricter infant-rice iAs cell (100, EU/US/UK/CA) and must be certified there instead.

iAs.label: read-across from the EU 2023/915 non-parboiled milled-rice inorganic-arsenic ML (150 ug/kg): rice/grain syrup arsenic derives from the rice, and this rice-grain value is stricter and more source-appropriate than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500). Infant-destined rice syrup escalates to the infant-rice iAs cell (100).

tAs.rationale: Total arsenic in rice/grain syrup is dominated by the rice-derived fraction, and the toxic species (inorganic arsenic) is the binding control at 150 ug/kg (read-across from the EU milled-rice iAs ML). The generic refined-sugar total-arsenic ML (100, MERCOSUR/Paraguay) is deliberately NOT applied here because it is incoherent with the rice-derived inorganic-arsenic load (inorganic <= total by identity, so a 100 total cannot coexist with a 150 inorganic control). Total arsenic is measured as a screen; the inorganic-arsenic ceiling governs.
tAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS as a screen; inorganic As by HPLC-ICP-MS is the binding measurement (150 ug/kg).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for rice/grain syrup, but rice and cereal grains accumulate nickel (EU regulates husked-rice Ni at 2000), so a source pathway exists. Held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for rice/grain syrup; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these syrups are sold in glass/plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for rice/grain syrup and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no mercury source in a grain syrup. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).
